text: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1140357. Source data from docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140357' and canonical_smiles is not null. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles in ascending order.
